enchantments.tooltip: Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
Strength +6: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Strength.
Speed +21%: +21% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 8% bonus to attack speed.
